name: Chastise
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Renamed from A Lack of Fear. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Your race is so very strong, adventurer. We are proud to call you allies. And as each day's sun sets, you and your kin grow closer to not only finding your true origins, but find great confidence that you are on the right path in so many things. That feeling must make you feel so triumphant.

Word came from Ironforge just recently. It asked that you return there and speak to High Priest Rohan in the Mystic Ward. I would not keep him waiting. May Elune guide your travels.
narrative.objectives: Speak to High Priest Rohan in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: You've got the makings of a great champion, adventurer. Keep up the good work!You've already shown you're ready for battle. Perhaps it's time we taught ya a little somethin' more.
